scope: One source mechanism audit; no repository change, device launch, compilation, or performance measurement.
conclusion: Do not device-launch the current prototype for correctness or timing evidence. Rebuild a real tile producer against the existing communication protocol.

server_snapshot.variant: Server kernel declares core_ratio(1,2); local source uses KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(MIX_AIC_1_2). Remaining kernel statements match; server lines after the declaration are one lower.
server_snapshot.exports: nm -D confirms fused_proj_reduce_demo(unsigned int,void*,unsigned long,int8_t*,int8_t*,float*,float*,uint8_t*,uint8_t*,int,int,int,int) and fused_proj_reduce_kernel. Existing binary CLI is <pe_size> <pe_id> <ip_port> <rows> <inner> <cols> <rounds>; presence is not a valid execution receipt.

defects.witness: Host allocates4096 bytes for tiling but never generates TCubeTiling or copies any content. Kernel reads those bytes and mm.Init consumes them. K is not otherwise passed into the kernel.
defects.consequence: No defined shape/configuration for the matmul; the existing executable is not a correctness harness.

defects.witness: One AIC and its two AIVs suffice: AIC sets mode0 flag5; AIVs wait on flag5 without an AIV mode0 producer. Mode0 synchronizes the same core kind. Mode2 supplies the intended one-AIC-to-two-AIV handoff.
defects.consequence: The first handoff has no valid release relation. The defect is mode0, not one producer versus two consumers by itself.

defects.root_cause: The outer tile loop reuses an asynchronous transfer stage before consumption.
defects.witness: For E>8192 floats, call0 issues MTE3 from stage for tile0 and returns without the final MTE3-to-MTE2 wait. Call1 can refill the same stage before call0 MTE3 consumes it. The SDK explicitly leaves that last wait to the caller. A distinct-valued tile1 can replace data from tile0. Quiet after all calls is too late.
defects.consequence: Incorrect data is permitted before the PE sync, even after the flag mode is repaired.

defects.root_cause: Single partial buffer has no consumer acknowledgement between internal rounds.
defects.witness: After publishing ready(r), AIC can write partial(r+1) while AIV still reads partial(r) for a push. The two window planes do not protect this separate single buffer.
defects.consequence: A protocol repair needs explicit producer-slot ownership; static identical all-ones rounds cannot expose this generation race.

unsupported_overlap_claim.actual_order: IterateAll(c) -> End() -> one PROJECT_READY -> all tile puts
unsupported_overlap_claim.conclusion: No tile-level compute/communication overlap is implemented. A true tile-ready producer has not been established.

reusable_protocol.pieces: TpPushPlane:48-59; TpPushPublish:64-83; TpPushReduce:85-119; stage0 dispatch in tp_push_once:486-526.
reusable_protocol.contract: Use one full-payload mte_put_nbi call per sender-to-peer, then each participating AIV quiet, vector PE sync, and ascending-rank reduction. The SDK full-payload loop handles staging reuse internally; do not replace it with repeated calls sharing one stage without ownership.
reusable_protocol.prior_numerical_receipt: docs/evidence/ascend-decode/onesided-allreduce-20261018/README.md documents wrong0 for the standalone protocol. No new receipt or latency is claimed here.
reusable_protocol.two_plane_invariant: Under matching PE round numbers and all-AIV participation, starting window reuse at r+2 requires passing sync(r+1); every peer reaches sync(r+1) after finishing reduction(r). Thus the window two-plane design has a valid reuse argument. This does not establish ownership of the producer partial or UB stage.
reusable_protocol.current_quiet_boundary: The inspected server quiet implementation has PIPE_ALL before its transport-mask branch (:92), then dcci. Historical text saying zero-mask quiet performs no MTE barrier does not describe this snapshot.

minimum_correct_two_die_version: Host establishes initialized TCubeTiling and actual NZ-packed weights for the declared M/N/K/dtypes. Start with one AIC and two AIVs to avoid an additional multi-core projection partitioning problem.

Producer exposes completed tile boundaries after their Fixpipe stores; use an appropriate AIC/AIV handshake and explicit ownership/consumed acknowledgement for every reused producer slot. Publishing only after IterateAll is not tile production.
Retain the established vector-side push/quiet/sync/ordered-reduce protocol and its two window planes; preserve UB stage ownership through the final MTE3 completion.

State the tail contract. Current ReduceStripe uses plain DataCopy(count), which rounds down non-32B counts; either restrict every span to multiples of8 float elements or handle the remaining elements explicitly. Rank, tile and generation tags must survive the tail.

Validate distinguishable rank/tile/generation data and output sentinels on both PEs for at least three generations with skew. Compare every element against a CPU reference. Three separately synchronized single-round launches cannot falsify an internal-round partial-buffer race; the internal loop needs distinguishable generations.

small_correctness_shape.reason: K32/N528 allow ordinary int8 NZ blocking; E8448 floats exercises one full8192-float chunk and an aligned256-float tail.
small_correctness_shape.heap_boundary: Existing host requests1GiB SHMEM heap per die; window resides inside that heap. Additional named non-heap allocations total89088 bytes, excluding runtime/workspace/alignment overhead. Logical buffers are223KiB per die; no measured peak-memory claim.
small_correctness_shape.entry: fused_proj_reduce_demo(1,stream,ffts,A,B_nz,partial,out,window,valid_tiling,16,528,rounds,round_base). This is the target call contract after reconstruction, not authorization to launch the broken implementation.
small_correctness_shape.payload: Use rank-distinct int8 activation and column/tile-varying NZ weights; add distinguishable generation inputs within a multi-round invocation. All-ones data masks rank duplication, layout permutations and stale-generation reads.
